# hestiacp_ssh_key (Resource)

Manages an SSH public key for a HestiaCP user. The key comment (third field) is used as the key identifier in HestiaCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) SSH public key in `TYPE BASE64 COMMENT` format, e.g. `ssh-ed25519 AAAA... my-key`. The comment is required and must be unique per user.

### Optional

- `user` (String) HestiaCP username. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Key identifier — the comment field of the public key.
